text.en: This Order may be cited as the Law Revision (Evidence Act (Cap. Citation. 108)) Correction Order 1987.

Subsection (l)(f) of Section 78 of the Evidence Act (Cap. 108) Correction to included in the Revised Edition of the Laws of Brunei is hereby Section 78( I )(f) corrected :-of the Act.

(a) by deleting the word "Brunei" which appears before the word "keeper" and substituting therefor the word "lawful"; and

(b) by deleting the word "Brunei" which appears before the word "custody" and substituting therefor the word "lawful".

This Order shall have effect as from 1st January, 1986. Commence· men!. Made this 9th day of April, 1987.

PENGIRAN BAHRIN (Pengiran Laila Kanun Diraja) Minister of Law and Attorney General
